entries.title: Revelation of John 12:1
segments: ¶And a great sign was seen in the heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars;

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:2
segments: and being with child she cried, [being] in travail, and in pain to bring forth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:3
segments: And another sign was seen in the heaven: and behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven diadems;

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:4
segments: and his tail draws the third part of the stars of the heaven; and he cast them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to bring forth, in order that when she brought forth he might devour her child.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:5
segments: And she brought forth a male son, who shall shepherd all the nations with an iron rod; and her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:6
segments: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has there a place prepared of God, that they should nourish her there a thousand two hundred [and] sixty days.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:7
segments: And there was war in the heaven: Michael and his angels went to war with the dragon. And the dragon fought, and his angels;

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:8
segments: and he prevailed not, nor was their place found any more in the heaven.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:9
segments: And the great dragon was cast out, the ancient serpent, he who is called Devil and Satan, he who deceives the whole habitable world, he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:10
segments: And I heard a great voice in the heaven saying, Now is come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ; for the accuser of our brethren has been cast out, who accused them before our God day and night:

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:11
segments: and *they* have overcome him by reason of the blood of the Lamb, and by reason of the word of their testimony, and have not loved their life even unto death.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:12
segments: ¶Therefore be full of delight, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has come down to you, having great rage, knowing he has a short time.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:13
segments: And when the dragon saw that he had been cast out into the earth, he persecuted the woman which bore the male [child].

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:14
segments: And there were given to the woman the two wings of the great eagle, that she might fly into the desert into her place, where she is nourished there a time, and times, and half a time, from [the] face of the serpent.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:15
segments: And the serpent cast out of his mouth behind the woman water as a river, that he might make her be [as] one carried away by a river.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:16
segments: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 12:17
segments: And the dragon was angry with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, who keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus.
